description: A fantastic opportunity to rent a beautifully presented room within a fully renovated shared house. Finished to a high standard throughout, this spacious room offers modern, comfortable living and is ideal for working professionals looking for quality accommodation. The room has been recently refurbished with contemporary décor, new flooring, and modern furnishings. The property itself has undergone a complete renovation and features a stylish communal kitchen with modern appliances, providing a clean and welcoming environment for all residents.
